source: FAR and HHS PMR Threshold Matrix

micro_purchase.description: Maximum for purchases using simplified methods without competition requirements

simplified_acquisition.description: Simplified Acquisition Threshold - full competition required above this

publicize.description: Synopsis on SAM.gov required above this threshold

cost_pricing_data.description: Truth in Negotiations Act - certified cost or pricing data required

congressional_notification.description: Congressional notification required above this threshold

enhanced_procedures_idiq.description: Enhanced evaluation factors, post-award notifications, debriefing documentation required for IDIQ orders

subcontracting_plan.description: Small business subcontracting plan required for large business primes

spe_approval.description: Senior Procurement Executive approval required for single-award IDIQ/BPA

j_a_approval.description: Approval thresholds for other than full and open competition (FAR 6.304)

notes: Above MPT ($15,000): HHS-653 Small Business Review Form required.
Above SAT ($350,000): Full Acquisition Plan, HHS Market Research Report, J&A for sole source, CPARS required.
Above $750,000: Subcontracting plan required for non-small business awards.
